_about: PURPLE Model GP: the entrants (concept/gp/run.js reads this list; the /concept/gp/ page shows them in this order). Every model gets the SAME frozen designer system prompt (concept/designer/prompt.js, untouched) and the SAME user message (the engine's own scenario, unchanged); only the model id, and where the model needs it the temperature / output-token setting, differ. All calls are UNTRAINED (x-middleware-record: metadata): these are other Mubit tasks and must not be trained. temperature: the frozen 0 where the model accepts it; null = the field is left out (Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 answer 400 'temperature is deprecated for this model', integrator probe 2026-10-24; GPT-6 Luna is a reasoning model and is sent no temperature too). max_tokens: the frozen 250 unless set; models that think before answering get 4000 (Sonnet / Opus used all 250 thinking, integrator probe 2026-10-25). provider: anthropic = Mubit's Anthropic path; openai = Mubit's OpenAI path (server/mubit.js, PROVIDER openai, max_completion_tokens); none = no language model: every decision takes the engine's own seeded fallback step (concept/benchmark/baselines.js noAiLlm), the control. colour: the entrant's identity colour on the page and in the race (contrast checked against the dark panel #121216; the control is grey and dashed).
